originating_constraint: Improve real API committed-token throughput without greedy-output, state, capacity or streaming regression.
downward_contract: Prompt initialization must not execute a serial full draft layer per prompt token; shifted target hidden independently determines each cache row. Preserve exact live KV and bounded cancellation.
composition_point: Complete weight-reusing multi-row target verifier and full-prefix state oracle before isolated service integration, then P65/P8192/P40000 O256 for configured drafts 2/3.

implementation.finite_precision: Same BF16 decode, per-thread K stride256 ordered FMA, 256-thread binary reduction, BF16 RNE, row-wise normalization and absolute RoPE. No changed recurrence.
implementation.cancellation: Poll before first batch and after each synchronized batch; poison/drain on cancellation, no ordinary reuse until full reset.
implementation.allocation: Construction-only; unchanged 8GiB reserve; production graph and installed ABI unchanged.
